summary: Configures authenticated GitHub Packages reads while staging immutable release candidates so package publication planning can complete before a release merges.
userImpact: Protected releases can stage the signed plugin package, image, and chart candidate without failing when the package planner checks existing GitHub Packages versions.
security: Candidate staging uses the job-scoped GitHub token through the generated npm configuration and retains the existing packages permission boundary.
The release remains fail closed when registry authentication or immutable package comparison fails.
documentation: Generated release notes record the authenticated package-planning correction and protected staging evidence.
rollback: Revert the workflow configuration to disable candidate staging; no public release tag or production package version is created by the staging workflow.
validation: Release-candidate workflow contract coverage for GitHub Packages registry configuration and job-scoped authentication
Local CI contract and release-note preflight validation
Protected merge-queue gating keeps EnterpriseGlue v0.20.0 blocked until exact-candidate staging succeeds
